policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For three blue with the bin near [121, 136], select blue near [81, 112], [107, 81], or [78, 162] when updated blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. Additional blue arrangement landmarks, when visible, are [79, 130], [90, 97], and [58, 89]. For two red with the bin near [112, 142], select red near [86, 171] or [108, 96] when updated red_deposited is respectively zero or one. Additional red arrangement landmarks, when visible, are [85, 117] and [95, 103]. For one red and three blue with the bin near [117, 152], finish red first, selecting red near [89, 169]; after one red deposit select blue near [85, 100], [63, 129], or [62, 76] when updated blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. Additional arrangement landmarks, when visible, are blue near [81, 150] and [106, 94], and red near [53, 121], [70, 113], [75, 87], and [82, 124]. These preferences apply only to approximately matching goals and layouts and select currently observed cubes, not fixed points independent of the scene.

edits.modify_from: Direct visibility of entry into the opaque bin is not required.
edits.modify_to: Direct visibility of entry into the opaque bin or disappearance of the released cube is not required. Override the completed transport-release-empty-withdrawal pattern only with affirmative evidence that the carried cube fell or settled outside the bin. An unheld cube newly visible near the release region is not by itself such evidence: image proximity and lack of a held label do not establish the carried cube's identity or a tabletop landing.
